full_prompt_en: A square editorial illustration shows two people standing outside a blue-green neighborhood building on a clear sunny day. The building fills most of the frame, its broad turquoise wall marked by subtle wear, rectangular windows, and thin dark seams. Across the upper level, a long horizontal window sits beneath a network of overhead wires. At the lower center, a shaded glass entrance is framed by pale trim and a narrow cream awning. A man in a light short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers stands just outside the doorway, facing it; beside him, a woman in a blue-gray top and dark skirt also looks inward. To their left, a vivid red vending machine with small indistinct markings stands against the wall. A leafy tree rises along the left edge, its pale yellow-green foliage casting speckled shadow across the blue surface. The right side of the building steps back into a darker narrow lane, while a sunlit cream wall and small square window break the otherwise teal expanse. At the bottom, pale paving is divided into broad rectangles with a few warm rust-colored strips. The image uses flat, layered shapes and sparse fine lines; grain and slight color misregistration give it a printed surface rather than smooth digital polish. Strong sunlight arrives from the upper left, making the facade bright while the doorway, side lane, and patches beneath foliage stay dark. The overall composition is quiet and observational, balancing broad turquoise geometry with small human figures, a red accent, and delicate tree texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形编辑式插画，两个人在晴朗日子里站在一座蓝绿色街区建筑外。建筑填满画面大部分，宽阔青绿色墙面带轻微磨损、矩形窗和细深色接缝。上层一扇长横窗位于架空电线网络之下。下方中央，带阴影的玻璃入口有浅色门框和窄奶油色遮阳篷。一位穿浅色短袖衬衫、深色长裤的男子站在门外，面向门；旁边一位穿蓝灰上衣与深色裙子的女子也望向内侧。左边一台鲜红自动售货机靠墙而立，上面的小标记难以辨清。左侧边缘升起一棵繁叶树，浅黄绿色枝叶在蓝墙上投出斑点影。建筑右侧退入较暗窄巷，一面阳光下的奶油色墙和小方窗打断原本大片青绿。底部浅色铺地分成宽阔矩形，间有少量暖锈色条带。图像使用平整层叠形状和稀少细线；颗粒与轻微色彩错位赋予它印刷表面，而非平滑数字抛光。强日光从左上方照来，使立面明亮，门口、侧巷和枝叶下方的部分区域保持深暗。整体构图安静而善于观察，以宽阔青绿几何形平衡小人物、红色强调和精细树叶肌理。
style_prompt_en: The illustration has a restrained printed editorial finish made from flat overlapping color planes, small grain, and fine economical line. Turquoise, dusty teal, cream, charcoal, and pale yellow-green form the main palette, with one compact saturated red accent. Broad rectangular masses establish order, while irregular speckled texture and delicate branching marks soften their edges. Tiny dark figures or accents can anchor a large open color field without dominating it. Strong clear daylight creates sharply divided lit and shaded areas, though the ink-like texture keeps transitions slightly worn. The composition is spacious and quiet, with a subtle nostalgic urban mood carried by measured color and simplified geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 这种插画具有克制的印刷编辑式完成面，由平整叠压色面、细颗粒和节省的纤细线条构成。青绿、灰青、奶油色、炭色和浅黄绿组成主要色盘，只有一小块饱和红色强调。宽阔矩形团块建立秩序，不规则斑点肌理与精巧分叉笔痕柔化边缘。微小深色形状或强调可以稳住大片开放色域，却不主导它。清亮强日光形成分明的受光与背阴区域，但墨色般肌理让过渡略带磨损感。构图宽裕而安静，以审慎色彩和简化几何承载细微怀旧的城市氛围。
theme_en: Two people outside a blue-green neighborhood building
theme_zh: 两人站在蓝绿色街区建筑外
name: Tatsuro Kiuchi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
